specDelivery: Inline Scalar.createApiReference configuration content; no separate spec URL advertised or guessed.
hashRepresentation: SHA-256 of JSON.stringify(parsed Scalar configuration.content), preserving parsed property order.

facts.finding: REST fills and averages use the traded outcome's price; NO is side-relative. Realtime fill prices use YES denomination.

POST returns canonical side-relative limits and filled notional. Terminal GET supplies status and filled quantity, not the POST principal. Netting or ALL collateral can change actual cash differently.
Positions are YES-positive and NO-negative. Opposite BUY nets existing inventory; an unbacked SELL becomes a complementary BUY.
Tournament cash is rounded to two decimals; preserving its numeric lexeme does not recover exact gross cash.
facts.conservativeAssumption: A plus/minus 0.010000 cash interval is an explicit conservative modeling assumption, not documented exact precision or proof of isolated activity.

facts.finding: Published transaction history is cursor-paginated. Its completeness flag can fail at a twenty-page internal budget. No order/fill linkage is documented; complete fills alone cannot establish complete isolated account activity.

historicalEvidence.limitation: Derived historical limit consistency supports side-relative pricing; it is not complete terminal cash/activity reconciliation.
